not_found.title: Page not found
not_found.description: This address does not match any page. It may have moved or never existed.

forbidden.title: No permission
forbidden.description: Your account cannot open this page. Ask an administrator, or sign in with a different account.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.description: This device has no network connection. The page will reload by itself as soon as the connection is back.

backend.title: Server unavailable
backend.description: OpenList could not reach the server. It may be restarting or temporarily down.
